messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate (5xx) and elevated latency for embeddings in eu-central-1. Pager triggered: genqueue saturation. Incident ID INC-2026-042. Severity: P1.
oncall-erin: I'm on it. Seeing spike in genqueue for embedder pods — OOMs and retries. Rolling restart in progress. ETA 10-15m for initial mitigations.
ops-jay: Thanks Erin. Need a short status page blurb we can publish immediately. Keep customer impact clear: are existing requests failing or degraded?
comms-ana: Drafting now. Quick Q: Do customers see errors or just slow responses?
oncall-erin: Mostly HTTP 500s when queue depth > ~400, otherwise higher latency (~500-800ms) for embeddings. Affected: embeddings API (eu-central-1). No impact to text-gen routes.
comms-ana: Ok first pass below — please edit inline: ```We are investigating elevated error rates and latency for the embeddings API in eu-central-1. Some requests may return 500 errors or experience increased latency. Our on-call team is applying mitigations; we will post updates every 15 minutes until resolved.```
legal-sam: Keep wording factual and avoid promising timelines. Suggest "currently investigating" and "may be impacted". Also avoid naming internal services.
comms-ana: Updated wording per legal: ```We are currently investigating increased error rates and latency affecting the embeddings API in eu-central-1. Some requests may return errors or experience increased latency. Our team is working on mitigations; we will provide updates every 15 minutes.```
ops-jay: Good. L10n — we need short translated snippets for FR/DE/JP for the status page and email template. Can l10n-team prep variants?
l10n-team: Can do. Will need the final concise English text (<=280 chars) to translate.
comms-ana: Condensed 280-char blurb: "Investigating increased error rates and latency for embeddings in eu-central-1. Some requests may return errors or be slower. Teams are working on mitigations; updates every 15 minutes"
oncall-erin: Technical update: root cause is a memory leak in the latest embedder binary causing pod restarts under sustained load. We've rolled back the deployment on a canary subset and increased pod count temporarily to drain backlog. Observed 40% drop in 5xx after rollback.
ops-jay: Good signal. Suggest published statuspage include impact scope + mitigation + ETA cadence. Also set incident page to "Partial degradation — ongoing".
comms-ana: Final publish copy ready: ```Incident status: Partial degradation (ongoing). Impact: Some requests to the embeddings API in eu-central-1 may return errors (5xx) or experience increased latency. Mitigation: We rolled back the recent embedder deployment on canary, increased capacity to drain the queue, and are monitoring. Next update: in 15 minutes.```
legal-sam: Approved. No customer-identifying claims.
l10n-team: We'll push translations in 10m. If we get a stable resolved signal earlier, tell us ASAP to stop translations.
oncall-erin: Request: ops-jay, please publish the update. I will post follow-ups with metrics.
ops-jay: Publishing now to status page and sending customer-facing email to active customers (subject: "Service notice: embeddings latency in eu-central-1"). I will attach the English blurb and ask support to route escalations to the incident channel.
incident-bot: Status page update published by ops-jay at 1769804360. URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-042
comms-ana: Thanks — will prepare the longer customer email with FAQs. Tagging support ops for potential inbound. :handshake:
support-note: Support team: use canned reply template: "We are investigating elevated errors/latency for embeddings in eu-central-1. For high-priority workflows, consider retry/backoff or route to non-eu regions if possible. We will update you every 15 minutes"
oncall-erin: Monitoring: error rate down 38% so far, latency trending down. If rollback fully stabilizes, we'll aim for resolved in 30-45m. Will post a "resolved" draft when stable.
ops-jay: Keeping status page cadence: next scheduled update at +15m (1769804450). If resolved earlier, we'll post immediate resolved notice.
comms-ana: Draft resolved notice (placeholder): ```Incident resolved. The embeddings API in eu-central-1 is operating normally. Root cause: memory leak in embedder binary introduced in recent deployment; mitigated via rollback. We are conducting a post-incident review and will follow up with permanent remediation timeline.```
legal-sam: Sounds good; don't include "operating normally" until we've validated 30 min of stable metrics. Maybe say "service restored" only after validation.
comms-ana: Adjusted resolved copy: ```Incident resolved. We believe service has been restored for the embeddings API in eu-central-1. Root cause: memory leak in embedder binary introduced in recent deployment; mitigated via rollback. We are validating stability and will update if anything changes.```
oncall-erin: Will confirm after 30m of stable error/latency metrics. I'll post a final confirm when done.
ops-jay: Thanks everyone. Closing loop: published initial update, translations queued, support notified. Keep this thread for publish edits only; operational updates go to the main incident channel.
incident-bot: Note: next automated reminder in 15 minutes for incident update.```
